originality.rationale: The nonmodular rank theorem assumes characteristic prime to the entire underlying group order; here characteristic p divides the displacement subgroup and the truncated-polynomial valuation factors are nonsemisimple. The four inspected primary full texts establish transport, Fourier/idempotent and zero-divisor-existence or small extended-graph facts but no exact modular distribution. A broadened unindexed theorem remains a residual risk, so no independent originality guarantee is claimed.
residual_risks: The full general characteristic-p group-algebra chain-ring structure is classical; a previously published specialized rank-census corollary could exist under ring-theoretic terminology not found in these searches.
No generality for noncyclic modular Sylow displacement is claimed.
A finite search cannot prove uniqueness of a mathematical statement.

value.rationale: The complete rank polynomials classify both left and right annihilator dimensions and the number of ordered zero products across an infinite modular nonassociative-algebra family. The effects of nonsemisimple chains (all valuation levels), nonsplitting finite-field orbits, and non-Latin fibers are captured in uniform exact formulas. These quantities are motivated by the naturally defined directed zero-divisor incidence relation and cannot be read off from a few small tables.
